caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware crock placed against a plain, light-colored background. The crock is cylindrical with a wide mouth and two small, curved handles on either side near the top. It has a grayish body with a smooth texture and is adorned with blue decorative elements, including a stylized floral or leafy pattern and some cursive or script-like designs near the top just below the rim. The illustration renders shadows and light on the surface of the crock, giving it a sense of dimension. The artist's signature, "Geo. A. Loughridge," appears in small letters at the bottom left of the page.
title: Small Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
